# LSE Blogs

> > Expert commentary and research insights from the London School of Economics covering politics, policy, and global affairs

LSE Blogs is the London School of Economics' platform for evidence-based social science writing, featuring specialized blogs on British politics, US politics, European politics, international relations, and regional expertise including China, Africa, and global health. The platform serves as a hub for academic research dissemination and expert analysis on contemporary political and social issues.

## Key Topics

- LSE (London School of Economics)
- British Politics and Policy
- US Politics and Policy
- European Politics
- International Relations
- China Dialogues
- Africa at LSE
- Global Health
- Policy Analysis
- Foreign Policy
- Political Commentary
- Social Science Research
- Academic Blogging
- Knowledge Exchange

## Platform Overview

- [LSE Blogs Homepage](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/): Main hub for LSE expert commentary on social and political issues
- [About LSE Blogs](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/about-lse-blogs/): Information about the LSE Blogs platform and its mission for evidence-based social science writing
- [LSE Research Blogs Directory](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/lse-research-blogs/): Complete directory of LSE research blogs covering politics, economics, and global affairs

## Regional Politics & Policy

- [British Politics and Policy](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/politicsandpolicy/): Analysis of UK government, governance, and public policy
- [LSE United States Politics and Policy](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/usappblog/): US politics and policy analysis from the LSE Phelan US Centre
- [LSE European Politics](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/europpblog/): European politics research covering EU policy, elections, and current affairs

## International Relations & Global Affairs

- [LSE International Relations Blog](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/internationalrelations/): Research, analysis, and student perspectives from the LSE Department of International Relations
